info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Network Participant Facility Management API
info.description: The Card Network Participant Facility Management API allows businesses to establish and manage participation facilities within a card network. This endpoint facilitates the creation of new participant facilities, enabling organizations to collaborate effectively in the payment ecosystem. Typical consumers include banks, financial institutions, or fintech companies looking to integrate or enhance their card operations. By using this API, businesses can streamline their onboarding process for card network participants and ensure compliance with network standards.

post.summary: Create a new card network participant facility.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new facility that a card network participant can use. It requires the relevant data related to the facility to be included in the request body.
